slice_16b_selection.title: Add staging RG ActualCost budgets with ops notify thresholds
slice_16b_selection.why_smallest: Complete live absence (budgets=[]), smallest ownership surface (Azure budget + action group only), no Staff API/Hermes runtime change, offline-verifiable from secret-free IaC/fixtures, builds on measured MTD costs.
acceptance_criteria: Azure Consumption budget exists on wh-staging-rg with amount >= measured MTD baseline and at least one notification threshold (e.g. 80% and 100%)
Azure Consumption budget exists on luna-sunset-staging-rg with the same properties
Action group used by budgets has a non-ARM ops receiver (email or webhook) — no secrets in git
Secret-free fixture + verifier prove budget names/scopes/thresholds without reading secret values
No Staff API, Hermes, DB schema, or guest/payment runtime behavior change in the 16B diff

steps: Record pre-create MTD ActualCost (read-only) for both RGs
Create budgets with notify thresholds only (no other resource changes)
Trigger a test notification or confirm Azure shows Enabled + threshold definitions
Re-run read-only budget list; freeze evidence JSON secret-free
Confirm docker/app revisions unchanged (zero runtime mutation)
